first_probability_record.scope: First 14 sporting match probabilities only; separate from full-ticket ROI protocol
first_probability_record.full_ticket_exclusion_reason: Pleno de selecciones, fuera del ámbito acordado de Primera y Segunda masculinas y Liga F
first_probability_record.primary_comparison: candidate minus comparator mean log loss, per competition
first_probability_record.market_policy: First eligible real market attachment before official close and all kickoffs; no later replacement
first_probability_record.deduplication: Use the first registered match prediction for model metrics; first eligible market comparison for paired market metrics
first_probability_record.limitations: Local clock and hashes; no external trusted timestamp and no actual bet
